<thought>To find the required template, I will search the retrosynthetic template catalog for templates that break an aliphatic hydroxyl group when applied to the given protected molecule. This should return the template ID and its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
